unit.why: A compilation of homiletic and ethical sources on the conduct of a rabbi/communal head (אב״ד): Rashi on 'Anokhi', a short saying of the Gostynin rebbe, R. Eliezer's testament, and quotations from Noam Elimelekh, Tefillah le-Moshe, and Dudaim ba-Sadeh; it contains no narrated event.
unit.boundary_note: The division ends with the heading 'מענין אברך' of the next section, whose story begins in the next division.
